resources.string: Open HMG-Seogaemo with the steering-wheel user button.

While enabled, Open HMG-Seogaemo replaces the current steering-wheel user-button assignment (for example, gohome). Disabling restores the exact previous assignment if it has not changed. Choosing another function in stock button settings overrides this shortcut and causes a conflict; HMG-Seogaemo will preserve that choice and keep the backup. This action does not appear in the stock button settings list.
